svg.title: Подъём штанги на бицепс у стены — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. STRICT WALL BARBELL BICEPS CURL, clearly side-front three-quarter view. Both poses show the same vertical wall behind the person as a thin vertical plane edge, upper back and hips visibly touching the wall throughout, feet a few inches forward. Hold ONE continuous straight barbell with both palms up and a plate on each end. LEFT bar against fronts of upper thighs, elbows nearly extended. RIGHT bar near upper abdomen/lower chest after curling, elbows stay against sides, shoulders and hips stay against wall. Include whole wall edge in each separate half, no bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
